description: Proactive threat hunting activities are not conducted to identify hidden threats. This signal indicates that undetected adversaries may persist in the environment.
applicability: Applicable to Level 3 environments requiring proactive security. Includes threat hunting teams, hypothesis-driven investigations, and proactive compromise assessments.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through threat hunting program review, hunting activity verification, and proactive security assessment.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 - System and Communications Protection
32 CFR Part 170 - Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification Program
